Subject: Request: VM artifacts for SIG/SOC2 — GreenWave audit window

Hi Sean,

We are preparing for an upcoming SIG review tied to our SOC2 refresh and need a concise VM evidence package from Redwood covering the following points:

- Verified scan cadence (types of scans, frequency, tooling) for production and build images.
- SLA for triage and remediation (time-to-triage, time-to-fix by severity).
- Representative CVE remediation attestations for high/critical findings in the last 12 months (signed/dated).
- Any compensating controls or exception logs for legacy components.

Can you provide the artifacts in a single package (preferred: ZIP with index) or a shared Drive folder? Our deadline for ingest to the SIG portal is 2025-11-21 EOD PST.

If possible, include a short one-page attestation PDF we can upload to the portal; signature from an authorized Redwood security or ops manager is fine. Also please include a HubSpot or DocuSign link for any formal attestation we need to archive.

Let me know if that deadline is unrealistic. I can extend to 11/24 if necessary, but earlier is better.

Thanks — looking forward to the packet.

Lena Ortiz
Security Assurance
GreenWave Financial
